name: apple-podcast-downloader

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.make: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-forge make

author: Drooxi
description: Desktop application for searching and downloading Apple Podcasts episodes.
